paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend. Bel and Nebo are gods that have to be carried. The LORD says the other direction: He carried Israel "from the womb" (Isaiah 46:3). So one kind of god is a load on your back, and the real God is the One who picks YOU up.

And He doesn't stop carrying when you get old. He says, "Even to your old age, I will be the same, and I will bear you up when you turn gray" (Isaiah 46:4). Friend, I know what it feels like to get worn down and think you're finished. He says, "I have made you, and I will carry you." That's a promise you can lean your whole weight on.

So why can we trust Him? Because He says, "I am God, and there is no other," and He declares "the end from the beginning" (Isaiah 46:9-10). A gold god can't move off its own spot, but His purpose will stand. Even to people He calls stubborn, He says, "My salvation will not be delayed" (Isaiah 46:13). So when something in your life is crying out to be your savior, baker, put it down and let the God who carries you carry you.
